fields.display_title: There is nothing particularly wrong with the paper - it is a nice work, that is based a lot on previous attempts, like those in Martens. Coming from a more theoretical background, I would like to see more theory. Nevetheless this does not lessens the value of the paper. For the moment, weak accept until I also read the other reviews.
